paragraphs: Petstablished sells shelter software that keeps pet data, medical records, tasks, contacts, documents, applications, fosters and adopters in one system. The buyers named on the homepage are animal welfare organizations of all sizes, described as shelters and rescues. Listed features cover medical record storage, medical reminders, adoption and foster contracts signed online, permissions groups, activity logs, reports and cage cards.

Available pets can be exported automatically to Petfinder and Adopt-a-Pet, and to over 200 pet adoption sites nationwide. Organizations can process adoptions and payments in the system, with an adopter donation button offered at the point of payment. Donation management can store donations as currency or items and sync a bank account so users donate online.

A microchip program gives organizations free access to software, free chips, and more for each adoption processed through the payment system. The microchip registry is integrated with the system, and a lost and found line is described as staffed at all hours of every day. Data can be imported from AdoptAPet, Petfinder, Rescue Groups, spreadsheets or another software vendor.

quote.text: Embed a pet adoption widget on your website or design your own with our customizable API.
